profile.description: Active Greenlee County Fair. Current 2026 coordinator is Justine Holguin; the 2026 fair already has a contracted carnival.

notes.subject: Contact changed; 2026 carnival already contracted
notes.body: Justine replied Aug. 13, 2026 that she is the new Events Coordinator for Greenlee County and the fair had already contracted a carnival, but she would keep Adventure Zone's information for future events. Current official county information confirms the fair is active Sept. 17-20, 2026 and lists the fairgrounds at 928-359-2032 / fairgrounds@greenlee.az.gov. Replace Lindsey as the working contact and do not send another 2026 pitch.

followUps.label: Check 2027 Greenlee County Fair provider plans
followUps.reason: The new coordinator kept Adventure Zone's information for future events; 2026 was already committed to a carnival. Reconnect early for 2027 if a separate family-entertainment area could fit.
